paper.title: Fortran 77 subroutines for computing the eigenvalues of Hamiltonian matrices II (HAPACK, Algorithm 854)

claim.text: WR(1), the real part of the first stable eigenvalue of the DHAESU example (tdhaesu.f reading dhaesu.dat, N=5), as the shipped reference output dhaesu.res prints it in 'The stable eigenvalues', row i=1: -3.1941 (4 decimals).

values.name: WR(1), DHAESU example first stable eigenvalue

attempt: The archive ships the Fortran 77 sources, the example data dhaesu.dat and the shipped output dhaesu.res, but the Src and Drivers makefiles include ../make.inc, which the archive does not ship, and the template Doc/make.inc names the compiler f77, which is not installed. The authors' documented make therefore fails at the compiler (original attempt). Build-only workaround: the 46 unedited Src .f files are compiled with gfortran -O2 -std=legacy (with -fallow-argument-mismatch, a gfortran default that rejects this old code otherwise) into hapack.a, and the unedited tdhaesu.f is linked against the system LAPACK and BLAS. No source byte is edited (manifests pre == mid == post). TDHAESU run on the authors' dhaesu.dat gives WR(1) = -3.1941, equal to the shipped value at the printed 4 decimals.

diagnostics.precision: Both the shipped reference and the run print WR(1) to 4 decimals; the tolerance 1e-4 is the registered value (rounding half-unit 5e-5 plus last-digit slack). The run prints S, T, G, U, V with more digits than the shipped file, which the shipped file lists to 4 decimals; that format difference is not compared.
diagnostics.conjugate_pair_order: The shipped file lists WI(2) = -0.3179 and WI(3) = +0.3179; this build prints WI(2) = +0.3179 and WI(3) = -0.3179 for the same conjugate pair (eigenvalues 2 and 3, real part -0.1350 in both). The claim is WR(1), which is not affected; the pair order is recorded here and not judged.

original_attempt.reason: The archive's documented make needs ../make.inc, which is not shipped; the template Doc/make.inc names f77, which is not installed in the sandbox (make: f77: No such file or directory, make exit 2).

environment.libraries: system LAPACK and BLAS (/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu liblapack.so and libblas.so, Debian reference packages; versions recorded on the host by dpkg-query, see evidence)

replayed.why: recipe printed no VALUE line for ['WR(1), DHAESU example first stable eigenvalue']
